questions.q:
When a number is divided successively by 6, 11, and 14, we get the remainders 3, 4, and 5 respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 14, 11, and 6, we get the remainders A, B, and C respectively. Find the value of (A + B - C).

जब किसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 6, 11 और 14 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः 3, 4 और 5 शेषफल प्राप्त होते हैं। जब उसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 14, 11 और 6 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः A, B और C शेषफल प्राप्त होते हैं। (A + B - C) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
Let the number is N, so when N is divided by 6, the remainder is 3. Let us say that the quotient is x. This x when divided by 11 leaves the remainder 4 and quotient y and when y is divided by 14, it leaves the remainder 5 and quotient z. This can be written as below:

N = 6x + 3... (1)

X = 11y + 4... (2)

y = 14z + 5... (3)

Putting equation (3) and (2),

X = 154z + 55 + 4 = 154z + 59... (4)

Putting equation (4) in (1),

N = 6 * (154z + 59) + 3 = 924z + 357.

Smallest such number is 357, when z = 0

Therefore, N = 357

Now, 357/14, quotient is 25 and remainder is 7.

25/11, the quotient is 2 and the remainder is 3.

2/6, the quotient is 0 and the remainder is 2.

So, A = 7, B = 3, and C = 2

Therefore, A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 10 - 2 = 8

Express Method

Let in the first condition, last quotient be 1.

So, dividend for 14 = 14 x 1 + 5 = 19

dividend for 11 = 11 x 19 + 4 = 213

dividend for 6 = 213 x 6 + 3 = 1281

So, the number is 1281.

Now,

(1281/14) = quotient = 25 and remainder(A) = 7

(25/11) = quotient = 2 and remainder(B) = 3

2/6 = remainder(C) = 2

Therefore,

A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 8

questions.q:
The average of 18 consecutive even numbers is P and when first 8 numbers are dropped, then average becomes Q. If P + Q = 50, then find the average of 4P and 2Q.

18 क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का औसत P है और जब पहली 8 संख्याएँ हटा दी जाती हैं, तो औसत Q हो जाता है। यदि P + Q = 50 है, तो 4P और 2Q का औसत ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions.s:
Let 18 consecutive even numbers be 'x', 'x + 2', 'x + 4', 'x + 6', ........., 'x + 34'.

According to the question:

P - 17 = Q - 25

Q - P = 8 ........ (1)

P + Q = 50 ...... (2)

From (1) and (2):

Q = 29 and P = 21

Required average = (4P + 2Q)/2 = 2P + Q

= 42 + 29

= 71

questions.q:
When y is divided by 29, the remainder obtained is 4. What will be the remainder when y5 is divided by 29?

जब y को 29 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 4 प्राप्त होता है। y5 को 29 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल कितना होगा?
questions.s:
Let us take an example to understand the concept of remainder:

When x is divided by y it gives the remainder 'a'. If we are performing any operation on x, then the same operation will be performed on 'a'.

Like, the remainder obtained on dividing xn by y is equal to the remainder obtained on diving an by y.

Here, remainder 4 is obtained on dividing y by 29. Then,

New remainder = remainder obtained when y5/29

= remainder obtained when 45/29

= remainder obtained when 1024/29

= 9

questions.q:

questions.s:
Required number = LCM of 36, 42, 54, 72 and 80

Factors of 36 = 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 22 * 32

Factors of 42 = 2 * 3 * 7

Factors of 54 = 2 * 3 * 3 * 3 = 2 * 33

Factors of 72 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 23 * 32

Factors of 80 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 2 * 5 = 24 * 5

LCM = 24 * 33 * 5 * 7 = 15120

questions_hin.q_hi:
When a number is divided successively by 6, 11, and 14, we get the remainders 3, 4, and 5 respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 14, 11, and 6, we get the remainders A, B, and C respectively. Find the value of (A + B - C).

जब किसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 6, 11 और 14 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः 3, 4 और 5 शेषफल प्राप्त होते हैं। जब उसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 14, 11 और 6 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः A, B और C शेषफल प्राप्त होते हैं। (A + B - C) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the number is N, so when N is divided by 6, the remainder is 3. Let us say that the quotient is x. This x when divided by 11 leaves the remainder 4 and quotient y and when y is divided by 14, it leaves the remainder 5 and quotient z. This can be written as below:

N = 6x + 3... (1)

X = 11y + 4... (2)

y = 14z + 5... (3)

Putting equation (3) and (2),

X = 154z + 55 + 4 = 154z + 59... (4)

Putting equation (4) in (1),

N = 6 * (154z + 59) + 3 = 924z + 357.

Smallest such number is 357, when z = 0

Therefore, N = 357

Now, 357/14, quotient is 25 and remainder is 7.

25/11, the quotient is 2 and the remainder is 3.

2/6, the quotient is 0 and the remainder is 2.

So, A = 7, B = 3, and C = 2

Therefore, A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 10 - 2 = 8

Express Method

Let in the first condition, last quotient be 1.

So, dividend for 14 = 14 x 1 + 5 = 19

dividend for 11 = 11 x 19 + 4 = 213

dividend for 6 = 213 x 6 + 3 = 1281

So, the number is 1281.

Now,

(1281/14) = quotient = 25 and remainder(A) = 7

(25/11) = quotient = 2 and remainder(B) = 3

2/6 = remainder(C) = 2

Therefore,

A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 8

questions_hin.q_hi:
The average of 18 consecutive even numbers is P and when first 8 numbers are dropped, then average becomes Q. If P + Q = 50, then find the average of 4P and 2Q.

18 क्रमागत सम संख्याओं का औसत P है और जब पहली 8 संख्याएँ हटा दी जाती हैं, तो औसत Q हो जाता है। यदि P + Q = 50 है, तो 4P और 2Q का औसत ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let 18 consecutive even numbers be 'x', 'x + 2', 'x + 4', 'x + 6', ........., 'x + 34'.

According to the question:

P - 17 = Q - 25

Q - P = 8 ........ (1)

P + Q = 50 ...... (2)

From (1) and (2):

Q = 29 and P = 21

Required average = (4P + 2Q)/2 = 2P + Q

= 42 + 29

= 71

questions_hin.s_hi:
We know that any power of 6 gives 6 as a unit digit. And unit digit of 5000 is 0 which also gives 0 as the unit digit irrespective of power.

Therefore,

Unit digit of 26632 + 5000125 = (6 + 0) = 6

questions_hin.q_hi:
Three numbers are in the ratio of 5:7:4. If the sum of smallest and largest number is 297, then find the average of all three numbers.

तीन संख्याएँ 5:7:4 के अनुपात में हैं। यदि सबसे छोटी और सबसे बड़ी संख्या का योगफल 297 है, तो सभी तीनों संख्याओं का औसत ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the numbers are 5m, 7m and 4m respectively.

7m + 4m = 297

m = 27

So, the average of all three numbers = 27(5 + 7 + 4)/3 = 144

questions_hin.q_hi:
When y is divided by 29, the remainder obtained is 4. What will be the remainder when y5 is divided by 29?

जब y को 29 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 4 प्राप्त होता है। y5 को 29 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल कितना होगा?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let us take an example to understand the concept of remainder:

When x is divided by y it gives the remainder 'a'. If we are performing any operation on x, then the same operation will be performed on 'a'.

Like, the remainder obtained on dividing xn by y is equal to the remainder obtained on diving an by y.

Here, remainder 4 is obtained on dividing y by 29. Then,

New remainder = remainder obtained when y5/29

= remainder obtained when 45/29

= remainder obtained when 1024/29

= 9

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find the least number, which is exactly divisible by 36, 42, 54, 72 and 80.

वह सबसे छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 36, 42, 54, 72 और 80 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Required number = LCM of 36, 42, 54, 72 and 80

Factors of 36 = 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 22 * 32

Factors of 42 = 2 * 3 * 7

Factors of 54 = 2 * 3 * 3 * 3 = 2 * 33

Factors of 72 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 3 * 3 = 23 * 32

Factors of 80 = 2 * 2 * 2 * 2 * 5 = 24 * 5

LCM = 24 * 33 * 5 * 7 = 15120

questions_hin.q_hi: 13. एक संख्या को 49 से विभाजित किया जाता है और शेषफल 9 बचता है। यदि उसी संख्या को 7 से विभाजित किया जाए, तो शेषफल क्या होगा?

13.(d) भाज्य = भाजक x भागफल + शेषफल

जब किसी संख्या को 49 से भाग दिया जाता है तो शेषफल 9 रहता है अर्थात, भाज्य = 49Q + 9

जब उसी संख्या को 7 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तब49Q+97=7×7Q+97=97 = 2

इसलिए शेषफल = 2
